This plot is intercropped, and for this kind of crop I do not usually spend much on purchased inputs. I have some schooling and I know fertilizer and improved seed can help, but with my resources I would be careful and rely more on manure, family work, and the rains. I would not irrigate here, and I would only bring in a little hired help when the work is heavy.
